items.title: Ethereum, Base developers abandon effort to align account abstraction proposals
items.summary: The talks to align two proposals, EIP-8130 and EIP-8141, fell short of a shared standard after the two sides diverged on priorities.

items.title: Solana transactions just got more than 3 times bigger, giving an edge over Ethereum
items.summary: Transaction V1 raises Solana’s limit to 4,096 bytes from 1,232, giving developers more room for multi-step trades, company-wallet approvals and privacy proofs.

items.title: CoinEx to cease operation after 9 years, citing ‘significant’ crypto contraction
items.summary: CoinEx said falling trading volumes and liquidity, along with rising regulatory and compliance costs, had exceeded “reasonable boundaries,” with withdrawals remaining open until Dec.

items.title: Banks Want More: Trade Groups Demand Stricter Stablecoin Limits in Clarity Act
items.summary: Eight trade associations say exceptions for interest-like rewards could pull deposits from banks and reduce lending.
